## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes.

## Motivation

Explain the problem being solved and link related issues.

## Verification

List the commands and device scenarios used to verify the change.

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`
- [ ] Relevant device or emulator behavior was tested, or the reason it was not tested is documented below.

## Risk and user impact

Describe compatibility, routing, privacy, security, battery, memory, migration, and rollback considerations that apply. Write `None` when no material impact is expected.

## Screenshots or logs

Add sanitized evidence when it helps reviewers. Never include proxy passwords, signing material, keys, tokens, authorization values, private endpoints, or unrelated application data.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes tests where practical.
- [ ] User documentation, privacy disclosures, third-party notices, and the changelog are updated when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, signing keys, private network details, build outputs, or unredacted logs are included.
- [ ] Native binary or JNI changes include provenance and validation for every affected ABI.
